===Levels 45–52/60: Shayzien Advanced Agility Course===
The [[Shayzien Agility Course#Advanced course|Shayzien Advanced Agility Course]] is an alternative for players who cannot access the [[Ape Atoll Agility Course]] or do not wish to train on the [[Wilderness Agility Course]]. Completing this course requires a [[crossbow]] and a [[mith grapple]]. Players can gain around 35,000 experience per hour at level 45.
